cases.name: blu-incoming-not-flagged
cases.note: Money arriving. Non-spend because blu says Incoming in the subject, so the app is repeating the sender rather than inferring — no flag. A flag here would cry wolf and teach people to approve past flags.

cases.name: blu-refund-not-flagged
cases.note: Refund, stated by the sender. Non-spend, no flag. Note it does not REDUCE spending — it sits in its own bucket, which is why a hold and its reversal do not cancel out. Pinned as current behaviour.

cases.name: blu-hold-counts-as-spend
cases.note: A card authorisation hold. Counted as spending today; its reversal arrives as a refund and does not cancel it, so the two together overstate the month. Pinned to make that visible rather than arguable.

bluAccount GLOBALSTORE *TEMPORARY HOLD Amount Rp10.000,00

cases.knownIssue: A hold and its reversal both land; the refund is non-spend so it never offsets the hold.

cases.name: grab-ride-learned-pattern
cases.note: Executed by a pinned learned pattern, so the executor is testable with no model. Amount is right; merchant is the driver plus half the receipt, and the row carries unverifiedPattern because nothing verified it.

email.subject: Your Grab E-Receipt
email.bodyPlain: Grab E-Receipt Bike Hemat Hope you enjoyed your ride! Booking ID: A-000111 Total Paid Rp9.000 Receipt issued by the driver Andi Pratama. 5.0 Compliments for driver Layanan Mantap Breakdown Fare 9.000 Fare 9.000 Total Paid 9.000

expect.merchantRaw: Andi Pratama. 5.0 Compliments for driver Layanan Mantap Break

cases.knownIssue: Merchant reads the driver's name and the fare breakdown. Coverage scores this 1.00 because it extracted something; only a plausibility check on the value catches it.

cases.name: grab-food-learned-pattern
cases.note: The sender's OTHER layout, under a byte-identical subject. Proves bodyContains is what separates them — subject matching alone scored a correct pattern at 0.52.

email.subject: Your Grab E-Receipt
email.bodyPlain: Your Grab E-Receipt Selamat menikmati makanan Anda! TOTAL Rp44.300 TANGGAL | WAKTU 12 Aug 26 Jenis Kendaraan: GrabFood Diterbitkan oleh Pengemudi Rudi Hartono Diterbitkan untuk Pelanggan Pesanan ID A-000222 Pesanan Dari: RUMAH MAKAN BAHARI

expect.merchantRaw: Pengemudi Rudi Hartono Diterbitkan untuk Pelanggan

cases.knownIssue: Merchant reads the driver, not the restaurant. The restaurant is in the same email after 'Pesanan Dari:'.

cases.name: grab-promo-refused-by-body-marker
cases.note: Grab sends three promos for every receipt. bodyContains refuses them without a model — measured, one word selects 11 ride receipts out of 128 emails and no promo.

cases.name: dup-split-charge-receipt
cases.note: The known miss: the merchant bills one figure and the bank posts two. Exact matching cannot see it, and matching sums of charges would merge unrelated purchases. Pinned unflagged so the gap is documented rather than rediscovered.

email.subject: Your Grab E-Receipt
email.bodyPlain: Grab E-Receipt Car Standard Hope you enjoyed your ride! Booking ID: A-000555 Total Paid Rp51.500 Receipt issued by the driver Bayu Nugroho. 5.0 Compliments for driver Aman Breakdown Fare 46.500 Platform Fee 5.000

expect.merchantRaw: Bayu Nugroho. 5.0 Compliments for driver Aman Breakdown Fare

cases.knownIssue: Split across two bank charges (5.000 + 46.500), so no exact twin exists and the duplicate goes uncaught.
